title: Reviewer prompts state the verdict choices once, up front, and an unusable environment is COULD_NOT_RUN
description: Renders product and code reviewer requests over a fixed fixture in interactive and headless modes: the product request opens with the four verdict choices once and names the unreachable-environment list once instead of three times; an install that serves an app but cannot be reached says COULD_NOT_RUN while the noApp rule stays unchanged; the code request states the no-weaken rule and autonomy once; and both reviewer requests stay at most 700 words excluding diff, criteria, memory and maps.

steps.name: reviewer prompts are verdict-first, deduplicated and at most 700 fixed words
